EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Resume Context

Resume context using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

resume_context(completed, remaining, evidence)

Example input

{
  "completed": [
    "schema"
  ],
  "remaining": [
    "backfill",
    "verify"
  ],
  "evidence": [
    "migration log"
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "completed": [
    "schema"
  ],
  "remaining": [
    "backfill",
    "verify"
  ],
  "evidence": [
    "migration log"
  ],
  "next": "backfill"
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py resume_context < examples/resume-context.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
